subject: Q4 MAP: success thresholds & cutover triggers for VeriTask pilot
messages:
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
To: Anna Kowalski <anna.k@veritask.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-22T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: Q4 MAP: success thresholds & cutover triggers for VeriTask pilot

Hi Anna — attaching our proposed mutual action plan and a first-pass evaluation test plan for the 4-week pilot. High level: we want to make the go/no-go decision at the end of week 3 based on defined acceptance tests so we have a short buffer for cutover work in week 4.

Key success buckets in this draft (see attached veritask_map_v1.xlsx and pilot_testplan_v1.md):
- Performance: p95 inference latency < 350ms at target concurrency (specified load).
- Quality: precision/recall thresholds per use case; baseline tests with labeled prompt set (10k samples) and pass rate >= 92%.
- Reliability: 99.9% availability during pilot windows and graceful fallback policy.
- Security/compliance: KMS key integration, audit log delivery, and SOC 2 evidence items.
- Business impact: reduce manual-review volume by 40% on the targeted workflow and meet avg triage time SLA.

Please review the acceptance tests in the test plan; items highlighted in yellow are must-pass exit gates for the mid-pilot review. If these look good, can you confirm the stakeholder list (engineering lead, security, procurement) and whether your procurement team needs a signed SOW before pilot kickoff?

Proposed timeline (we're flexible within the week):
- Kickoff / sync: week of Nov 29
- Data ingestion & integration: week 1
- Controlled load & baseline runs: week 2
- Mid-pilot acceptance review (go/no-go): end of week 3
- Cutover prep & buffer: week 4

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you prefer to walk through the MAP together.

-Jasmine Liu
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: veritask_map_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), pilot_testplan_v1.md (evaluation checklist)

From: Anna Kowalski <anna.k@veritask.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@veritask.com, pilot-team@veritask.com
Date: 2026-11-23T10:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Q4 MAP: success thresholds & cutover triggers for VeriTask pilot

Thanks Jasmine — this is a helpful start. A few quick notes after a run-through with our engineering and procurement leads: 

1) Security: our security team will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and confirmation that audit logs from the inference cluster are forwarded to our SIEM (we can share the ingestion details). Please add a checklist item for KMS key rotation policy and retention timelines.

2) Performance thresholds: can we make p95 latency a hard mid-pilot gate? Engineering asks that p95 < 350ms under the agreed synthetic load.

3) Quality thresholds: procurement would like an explicit statement about false-positive tolerance on high-risk classifications — we suggested < 3% FP in the pilot acceptance criteria.

4) Procurement: they prefer to receive a short SOW + invoice schedule prior to kickoff. If Redwood requires a PoP (proof of payment) or initial invoice, loop us in and we can expedite review.

We can accept the proposed week windows but request the mid-pilot review be scheduled between Nov 23–27 if possible (our availability is better that week).

I'll loop in Kurt from procurement on the SOW thread.

—Anna
Anna Kowalski | Head of Data Products, VeriTask
pilot-team@veritask.com
Attachments: none

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Anna Kowalski <anna.k@veritask.com>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-24T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q4 MAP: success thresholds & cutover triggers for VeriTask pilot

Anna — thanks for the clear feedback. Quoting your asks below and adding internal action items.

> "SOC 2 Type II evidence and audit log forwarding to our SIEM"
We will: 1) provide the SOC 2 report excerpt that maps to the MAP controls; 2) share the audit-log forwarding playbook. Security will validate ingestion details by end of week 1.

> "Make p95 latency a hard mid-pilot gate"
Accepted — we'll mark p95 < 350ms as a must-pass mid-pilot exit gate in the MAP.

> "False positives < 3% on high-risk cases"
Added to the quality acceptance criteria. Marissa, please pull the labeled set and run the first pass baseline before the kickoff.

Internal owners / next steps: 
- Jasmine: update MAP and test plan to include SOC 2 checklist + FP threshold.
- Marissa: baseline labeling run + upload results to shared Drive (pilot_metrics_matrix.csv) by Nov 30.
- Dylan: draft a short SOW with payment schedule and cancellation terms; share initial doc for procurement review.

Can we propose a concrete mid-pilot review slot on Tue Dec 8 10:00 AM PT? That gives us time to run baselines and produce a short readiness report. If VeriTask prefers an earlier slot we can try to accelerate. 

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
Attachments: pilot_metrics_matrix.csv

From: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
To: Anna Kowalski <anna.k@veritask.com>, procurement@veritask.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Finalized MAP & acceptance triggers (confirmed)

Anna / team — following our thread and internal updates, attached is the finalized MAP and acceptance checklist (map_final_v1.pdf). Summary of agreed decision gates and acceptance tests: 

Pre-flight (kickoff readiness) — must be complete before synthetic runs: 
- Data ingress validated (sample ingestion + schema checks)
- KMS integration verified and test encryption keys rotated once
- SOC 2 artifacts shared with VeriTask security and mapped to MAP controls

Mid-pilot (hard go/no-go) — evaluated at mid-pilot review (Tue Dec 8, 10:00 AM PT):
- Performance: p95 inference latency < 350ms at agreed concurrency sustained for two 15-minute windows
- Quality: labeled test suite (10k samples, stratified across use cases) with pass rate >= 92% AND false positives < 3% on high-risk subset
- Reliability: no more than one outage incident > 5 minutes during the pilot windows
- Security: audit log forwarding to pilot SIEM validated (sample logs delivered)

Final acceptance (end of week 4) — production cutover if: 
- All mid-pilot gates met or a documented mitigation/rollback plan approved
- SOW executed and first invoice processed per agreed schedule
- Playbook for fallbacks and escalation contacts published to shared Drive

Attachments included: map_final_v1.pdf (final MAP), pilot_metrics_matrix.csv (baseline and target matrix).

Next steps: 
- Marissa will upload baseline results by Nov 30 (done).
- Dylan to share SOW draft to procurement by tomorrow for Kurt's review.
- Confirmed mid-pilot review: Tue Dec 8 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite to follow).

If everyone is aligned I'll send the DocuSign-ready SOW and a final readiness checklist 48 hours before the mid-pilot review.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting this across the line.

-Jasmine Liu
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — redwood.com
